HomePage.title: PASSENGER TRANSPORTATION
HomePage.workDescriptionTitle1: Fill out the booking form on the website
HomePage.workDescriptionTitle2: We will call you back and discuss the departure date.
HomePage.workDescriptionTitle3: On the day of departure, you arrive at the departure point.
HomePage.workDescriptionTitle5: Get on the bus and we will take you to your destination.
HomePage.serviceDescription: We provide comfortable and safe transportation services between Moldova, Germany
HomePage.serviceBlock1Description1: We transport with care, with vehicles equipped with ergonomic seats, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and generous luggage space.
HomePage.serviceBlock1Description2: We ship packages quickly and safely, guaranteeing delivery on time and in perfect conditions.
HomePage.serviceBlock1Description3: We offer regular passenger transportation services from Germany to Moldova.
HomePage.advantagesBlockDescription1: We deliver each passenger directly to the specified address — without unnecessary transfers and inconveniences.
HomePage.advantagesBlockDescription2: During the trip, there are stops where you can enjoy hot meals, as well as have coffee or tea in a cozy setting.
HomePage.advantagesBlockDescription3: On the road, you have access to stable Wi-Fi, so you can stay connected, work, or relax online throughout the route.
HomePage.advantagesBlockDescription4: Our transport meets modern standards of comfort and safety to make the trip as pleasant as possible.
HomePage.advantagesBlockDescription5: We deliver parcels on the Moldova - Germany route quickly and carefully, with full responsibility and hand-to-hand delivery.
HomePage.advantagesBlockDescription6: The trip takes place with two drivers who work in shifts — this ensures safety and allows you to get to your destination faster.

AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.description: We provide comfortable and safe transportation services between Moldova, Germany, and Denmark.
AboutPage.text: Our company strives to provide high-quality service, convenience, and reliability for our customers. We pride ourselves on offering modern vehicles equipped with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, and spacious luggage compartments. Our team of professional drivers ensures a safe and timely journey for all our passengers. We also offer parcel delivery services, guaranteeing fast and reliable delivery in perfect condition. By choosing us, you choose comfort, safety, and reliability in every trip.
